capabilities: Render .drawio, .vsdx and .pptx files inline via a rich-view code block
Zoom, pan and magnify diagrams and slides
Switch between diagram pages and slides with tabs
Pin page, zoom and position into the code block
Download third-party shape libraries (AWS, Azure, GCP, Cisco) on demand
disambiguation: Not a diagram editor; it only renders and navigates existing .drawio, .vsdx and .pptx files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; demo GIFs are listed as coming soon. Includes an installable skill for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot). Documented known rendering limitations for Visio and PowerPoint (e.g. no legacy .vsd/.ppt, approximated arrowheads, no animations).
problem: Obsidian cannot display diagram and presentation files like .drawio, .vsdx or .pptx inside notes or open them in a viewer tab.

relations.evidence: Searchable from Rich Search. Click a result and it jumps to the page or slide
the libraries come from draw.io's official repo and are kept locally

summary: Inline viewer that renders draw.io, Visio and PowerPoint files in notes with zoom, pan, page tabs, shape links and a magnifier.
